title: Glowing snowman
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- shadow on ground -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#2a3a55' opacity='0.7'/>
    <!-- bottom snowball -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='75' r='20' fill='#e8f4ff'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='75' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#bcd8f0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <path d='M36 81 Q50 86 64 81' fill='none' stroke='#cfe6fa' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- middle snowball -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='15' fill='#eef8ff'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='15' fill='none' stroke='#c6def2' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='11' fill='#f4fbff'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='11' fill='none' stroke='#cfe6fa' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <!-- hat brim -->
    <rect x='38' y='19' width='24' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ff7b6b'/>
    <!-- hat top -->
    <rect x='42' y='6' width='16' height='14' rx='2' fill='#ff9a8b'/>
    <rect x='42' y='15' width='16' height='4' fill='#ffe08a'/>
    <!-- pom pom -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='6' r='3' fill='#ffe08a'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='46' cy='30' r='1.8' fill='#3b5cff'/>
    <circle cx='54' cy='30' r='1.8' fill='#3b5cff'/>
    <!-- carrot nose -->
    <polygon points='50,34 61,36 50,38' fill='#ff9f1c'/>
    <!-- smile: coal dots -->
    <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#3b5cff'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='40' r='1.2' fill='#3b5cff'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='40' r='1.2' fill='#3b5cff'/>
    <circle cx='56' cy='38' r='1.2' fill='#3b5cff'/>
    <!-- scarf -->
    <path d='M37 41 Q50 46 63 41 L63 46 Q50 51 37 46 Z' fill='#7ed957'/>
    <path d='M60 44 L66 60 L60 61 L56 47 Z' fill='#5cb838'/>
    <path d='M60 58 L66 60 L62 65 Z' fill='#5cb838'/>
    <!-- middle buttons -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='1.6' fill='#3b5cff'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='56' r='1.6' fill='#3b5cff'/>
    <!-- bottom buttons -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='1.8' fill='#3b5cff'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='78' r='1.8' fill='#3b5cff'/>
    <!-- stick arms -->
    <path d='M35 50 L20 42 M20 42 L14 44 M20 42 L16 36' fill='none' stroke='#c98a3e' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M65 50 L80 42 M80 42 L86 44 M80 42 L84 36' fill='none' stroke='#c98a3e' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- sparkle glow accents -->
    <path d='M22 32 l2 4 l4 2 l-4 2 l-2 4 l-2 -4 l-4 -2 l4 -2 z' fill='#9fe8ff' opacity='0.9'/>
    <path d='M80 68 l1.5 3 l3 1.5 l-3 1.5 l-1.5 3 l-1.5 -3 l-3 -1.5 l3 -1.5 z' fill='#9fe8ff' opacity='0.9'/>
  </g>
</svg>
